title: Put it in the diary
drDigitalIntro:
The dates are settled. Get them written down where they will not be forgotten.
There are no step-by-step instructions here. You get a list of things to accomplish and you decide how.
• Nothing glows yellow. No control is highlighted.
• Do the objectives in any order.
• Open the checklist with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
• The Hint button gives a nudge toward where to look — never the answer.

playgroundTask.goal: The trip is in the calendar and the packing is on a list
playgroundTask.hint: A day has to be chosen before an event can be added to it. Reminders are a separate view from the calendar — look for the way to switch between them.

steps.say: There is an event in the calendar on a Thursday.
The event has a time on it.
The event is saved, not still being edited.
You are looking at reminders rather than the calendar.
There is a reminder that says Pack sunscreen.

drDigitalSuccess: A trip that is written down is a trip that happens. That is the whole point of a calendar.
drDigitalHint: Pick the day first, then look for the way to add something to it. Reminders live behind a switch near the top.
